MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Madhya Pradesh Professional Selection Board (MPESB) has released the answer key for the post of Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts. This recruitment was released for 2106 posts. Applications for the MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 04 August 2026, to 21 August 2026. The written examination was held on 22 September 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can check their MPESB Group 2 Sub Group 4 Patwari & Various Posts Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 04 August 2026
  • Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 August 2026
  • Correction Last Date : 23 August 2026
  • Exam Date Start : 22 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 19 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 19 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, Other State : Rs. 500/-
  • SC, ST, OBC : Rs. 250/-
  • EWS, PH (Divyang) : Rs. 250/-
  • Correction Charge : Rs. 20/-
  • Portal Charges Extra : Rs. 60/-

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.
